description: Phase 3 T5 PROBE -- CONTROL (known positive). Throwaway 1 km probe run, not a shippable scenario: it exists to answer the multicell initiation question against the classifier pre-registered in docs/phase3-t5-multicell.md §3, which was committed before this config was written. Expected: SUPERCELL. supercell_333m's storm keys at probe resolution. Calibrates the UH scale for decision-rule criterion 1; its umove/vmove are the validated Bunkers right-mover estimate, kept as-is. Probe geometry is T4 §5.2's: 180x180 @ 999 m = 179.82 km, 2 h, dtl=6, ~13 min per run instead of ~4.5 h at 333 m. The 1 km caveat is stated in docs §6.1 -- component counts may bias low; the REGIME call is what survives at this resolution.
